gui.neoorigins.creator.stub: %s taabu - imuse ni kan nigbamii 2.1 alakoso
origins.neoorigins.human.name: Eniyan
origins.neoorigins.human.description: Eniyan deede, laisi awọn agbara pataki ṣugbọn awọn agbara ti o ni iyipo daradara.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Idapọmọra
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: Awọn eniyan inu omi ti a bi ni ita gbangba - nmi omi ati we pẹlu irọrun, ṣugbọn o lọra ati gbẹ lori ilẹ gbigbẹ.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: Agbo
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: Fífẹ́fẹ́ olóore ọ̀fẹ́ tí ń fò lọ díẹ̀díẹ̀, tí kò bẹ̀rù ibi gíga, tí ó sì ń wo ayé láti òkè.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: gbigbona
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: Ti a bi ti awọn ina nether - iwọn ni brimstone, ti a tun pada ni ijọba dudu, ṣugbọn ti o jẹ oloro nipasẹ omi ati ojo.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: Amọja ọkọ ofurufu mimọ - ga soke nipasẹ awọn ọrun, ti ko fọwọkan nipasẹ awọn ipa kainetik, ṣugbọn ẹlẹgẹ ti fireemu ati ko lagbara lati ru ihamọra eru.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Enderian
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: Bi lori awọn lode erekusu ti awọn Ipari - teleports ni ife, dodges projectiles sinu ofo, ati ki o rin airi nipa endermen. Omi n jo bi acid.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Awọn eniyan alantakun nimble ti o ṣe iwọn odi eyikeyi, ti n fọ awọn oju opo wẹẹbu si awọn ọta, ti o si lu pẹlu ẹgan - ibatan si awọn crawlers ẹlẹsẹ mẹjọ ti agbaye.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Shulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: Ti o ni ihamọra bi shulker - fa awọn fifun kuro, pada sẹhin sinu ikarahun kan nigbati o ba ni igun, o si ṣe ifilọlẹ awọn ọta si ọrun pẹlu levitation ti nwaye. O lọra, ṣugbọn ko ṣee ṣe.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Irokuro
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: Ẹya irisi kan - ti nrin ni alẹ lori awọn iyẹ elytra, ti o nfa agbara lati awọn ipaniyan, ṣugbọn ina nipasẹ oorun ati ko le sinmi.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: Nmi labẹ omi lainidi ati rii ni kedere nipasẹ omi laisi kurukuru.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: O rii kedere ni awọn ijinle dudu. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Gbigbe Jade
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Afẹfẹ ami si isalẹ nigba ti o ba jade ninu omi: dada gun ju ati awọn ti o suffocate. Ojo, cauldron omi kan, Mimi omi tabi omi ti nṣiṣe lọwọ ti o wa nitosi gbogbo wọn mu kuro.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: Ko gba bibajẹ lati ja bo - awọn iyẹ mu afẹfẹ.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: O lọra Ja bo
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Toggleable: drifts laiyara sisale. Alaabo nipasẹ aiyipada. Akiyesi: Awọn deba to ṣe pataki nilo ja bo ni deede, nitorinaa pa eyi mọ lati sọ.
Nlo 75% kere si agbara lati gbogbo awọn iṣe.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Keen Oju
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: Awọn oju didan - wo diẹ dara julọ ninu okunkun.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Egungun ṣofo
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 ọkàn (-2 max HP). Ara ina, fireemu ẹlẹgẹ.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Iye Hop
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Flutter-fo si oke pẹlu fifun ni iyara ti apakan. Ko si iye owo ebi.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: Ajesara si ina, lava, magma, ati sisun - ina laarin awọn idahun ina laisi.
+3 ọkàn (+6 max HP). Awọn awo brimstone mu ara le.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: Ni iyara lori ilẹ ile - gbigbe yiyara lakoko ti o wa ni Nether (ko si aami ipa ti o han).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: Awọn ọwọ igboro mi ni ipele okuta-pikaxe - fọ okuta, awọn irin, ati netherrack laisi awọn irinṣẹ.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Iná inu gbigbona njo - ebi npa 25% yiyara.
Omi jẹ majele - gba ibajẹ 1.5 fun iṣẹju kan lakoko ti o wa ninu omi tabi ojo.
Awọn oju aifwy si infurarẹẹdi - wo kedere ninu okunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Firebolt
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: Gbe bọọlu ina kekere kan si itọsọna ti o n wa. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Gba iyara ti nwaye nigba ifilọlẹ pẹlu elytra kan.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Adayeba ofurufu
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Gbe bi olumulo elytra - ko si ohun kan ti o nilo. Tẹ fo lakoko ti o ṣubu lati tan awọn iyẹ rẹ.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: Iyara ọkọ ofurufu + 30% - ọrun tẹ si ọ.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Isubu iye
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: Ajesara si ibajẹ ijamba elytra - fo sinu awọn odi laisi abajade.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Fireemu ẹlẹgẹ
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Iho eye egungun - meji díẹ max ọkàn.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Ko le wọ irin, goolu, diamond, tabi ihamọra netherite - alawọ ati chainmail nikan. Awọn iyẹ gbọdọ wa ni imọlẹ.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Stampede
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: Gba agbara siwaju lori awọn ẹsẹ ti o nipọn. Awọn idiyele 2 stamina. 4-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Slam ilẹ
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Slam aiye pẹlu awọn ọwọ irin - 4 bibajẹ ati Slowness II fun awọn aaya 4 si gbogbo awọn ọta ti o wa nitosi ni rediosi 5-block. Awọn idiyele 3 stamina. 7-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Endermen foju foju wo wọn - wo wọn laisi ikọlu ikọlu kan.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% aye lati teleport kuro ki o yago fun ibajẹ nigbati o ba kọlu nipasẹ iṣẹ akanṣe kan.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: Mu 2 bibajẹ fun iṣẹju kan lati olubasọrọ pẹlu omi tabi ojo.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Ogun ipari
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Teleport si ibiti o n wa - to awọn bulọọki 50. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara. 3-keji itutu.
Dimọ si eyikeyi dada inaro - tẹ si odi kan lati dimu, fo lati gun, di ajiwo lati duro si aaye. Ibajẹ isubu ni a yago fun lakoko mimu.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Nlọ nipasẹ awọn oju opo wẹẹbu lai ṣe fa fifalẹ ati fọ wọn fẹrẹẹ lesekese.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Kika bi arthropod - afikun bibajẹ lati Bane of Arthropods ohun ija.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Awọn ikọlu Melee abẹrẹ majele - awọn ibi-afẹde jiya Majele I fun iṣẹju-aaya 3.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Ju a cobweb ti o gbe ara lori ikolu, tangling ohunkohun ti o de lori. Awọn idiyele 2 agbara.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Resistance Yẹ I - ikarahun fa awọn fifun ti yoo fa ara ti o tutu.
Ti nṣiṣe lọwọ: tusilẹ ti nwaye ti awọn ikarahun levitation - awọn ọta nitosi leefofo soke fun iṣẹju-aaya 3. Awọn idiyele 2 stamina. 8-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Nṣiṣẹ: parẹ sinu ikarahun rẹ ki o tun han si awọn bulọọki 12 kuro. Awọn idiyele 3 stamina. 10-keji itutu.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: Ajesara si levitation - ikarahun rẹ jẹ ki o fidimule nigbati awọn ọta ibọn ba pada.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Le ri kedere ni lapapọ òkunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Ko nilo lati simi. Le ye laelae labẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Fọọmu Phantom
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Di alaihan o si n lọ laini iwuwo.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Spectral Iyẹ
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Gbe bi olumulo elytra - ko si ohun kan ti o nilo. Tẹ fo lakoko ti o ṣubu lati tan awọn iyẹ rẹ.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Awọn anfani ti nwaye ti iyara nigbati ifilọlẹ sinu ọkọ ofurufu - awọn phantoms gùn awọn iyẹ wọn lile.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Oṣupa oṣupa
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Resistance I labẹ oṣupa (alẹ nikan) - oṣupa ibori fọọmu irisi. If'oju awọn ila aabo.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Imugbẹ Ọkàn
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Larada 1 HP ni gbogbo igba ti o ba pa ohun alãye kan.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Ti ko ni iwuwo
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: Ko gba ibajẹ isubu - awọn ara iwin ko de.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Sunburn
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Mu ina ati gba ibajẹ 1.5 fun iṣẹju kan ni imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: Fọọmu ẹlẹgẹ
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 ọkàn (-4 max HP). Ara owusu jẹ rọrun lati tu.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Ìpayà àìsùn
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Ko le sun - oru ni eroja rẹ.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Abo
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: Eniyan ologbo ti o yara ti o ni iranran alẹ ti o ni itara ati fifo kan - awọn ilẹ lori ẹsẹ wọn, yọ awọn wolves ati ocelots kọja, ṣugbọn korira omi ati sisun nipasẹ agbara ni iyara.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: Nigbagbogbo gbe lailewu. Ko gba bibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Le ri kedere ninu okunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: Yara
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: Gbigbe 10% yiyara ju eniyan deede lọ.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Ibanujẹ Apanirun
